$comment: Messages the shared webview bundles can post that desktop/src/main.ts does not handle.
Checked by scripts/validate-desktop-contract.js (npm run check:contract in desktop/).
status 'hidden': the controls that post it are hidden; hiddenBy is the CSS that hides them, injected by main.ts.
status 'gap':    the control is still visible and does nothing in the desktop app. A known gap, not a decision.
status 'no-op':  a background notice (telemetry, preference, failure report) with no visible control; ignoring it is harmless.
Remove an entry when its command gets a handler in registerIpcHandlers: the check fails on stale entries.
unresolvedControlSites (per 'hidden' entry): 'file#function' -> reason, for a post site whose control the check cannot determine; every other site's control must be in hiddenBy.

unresolvedComputedCommands: postMessage sites ('file#function:expression') whose command name is computed at runtime and cannot be resolved from data-* markup or a literal-union parameter; each needs a reason.

Insight 'execute' buttons post a VS Code command id taken from the insight data. The desktop sends insights: [], so no such button is rendered.
